source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
When a rule places one model where another was, or replaces one model with another:

1. Mark the battlefield point under the centre of the replaced model’s base (for a **FRAME** unit, its central axis).
2. Put the new model’s base centre (or central axis, for **FRAME**) right over that point.

If that would stack it on another model or leave it overhanging the battlefield edge, place it as near that point as it can go instead.
